description: Recent NYC property sales from the NYC Department of Finance Citywide Rolling Calendar Sales dataset: address, neighborhood, building class, units, year built, sale price and sale date. Newest first. Optional borough filter. Data lags the city's publication schedule. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_commercial_property_transactions when you need recently recorded NYC real-property documents; realestate_auction_com_property when you need HUD homes for sale by online bid in a US state or city. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

borough.description: Optional: manhattan, bronx, brooklyn, queens or staten island
